title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
slides: Anthropic's new tools: what is your AI spend buying?
They reveal which tasks consume the most tokens
But cost per task often hides the real bottleneck
Teams can now reprice workflows before the next invoice
Audit one high-cost workflow today and compare
thread_text:
1. The invoice you don't read

Anthropic's new tools show exactly which tasks burn the most tokens — and most teams have never checked.

2. Token hogs exposed

High reasoning and long context requests are devouring your budget, while simple formatting tasks barely register.

3. The hidden bottleneck

Cost per task feels cheap until you realize the real drag is the human time spent fixing outputs that never needed expensive models.

4. Reprice before renewal

You can now remap each workflow to the cheapest model that still delivers, and see the impact before the next bill hits.

5. Audit one workflow now

Pick your most expensive workflow today. Compare its token cost to a cheaper model on the same task. If you haven't done it, that's your bottleneck.
